name: GLM 5.1
short: Z.ai's 744B/40B-active MIT MoE (200K) for multi-hour agentic coding; SWE-bench Pro 58.4%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 56.9% (Vals AI) - no -coding SKU ever existed.
